title: Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.13755v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training long-horizon language model agents requires assigning credit to intermediate decisions from sparse terminal feedback. Within a finite group of sibling rollouts, useful action comparisons depend on their context, evidence for both alternatives, and how that evidence enters learning. We propose Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization (MCGPO), a procedure for constructing weighted action preferences from already collected trajectories. MCGPO defines comparison contexts with pre-action state summaries and observed rubric progress, annotated by task rules. Two-action support selects among ordered exact and coarse matching rules. Fixed folds separate candidate decisions from the terminal outcomes used to orient their preferences, and support-dependent evidence weights scale an auxiliary pairwise objective alongside shared GraphGPO task learning. MCGPO reuses rollout data and each response's original history, preserving critic-free

translated_title: 面向大语言模型智能体训练的匹配上下文群组策略优化
translated_abstract: 训练长时程语言模型智能体需要从稀疏的终端反馈中为中间决策分配信用。在有限的同批rollout群组内，有用的动作比较取决于其上下文、两个备选方案的证据支持，以及这些证据如何进入学习过程。我们提出匹配上下文群组策略优化（MCGPO），这是一种从已收集轨迹中构建加权动作偏好的方法。MCGPO通过动作前的状态摘要和观察到的评分标准进展来定义比较上下文，并由任务规则进行标注。双动作支持机制在有序的精确匹配与粗略匹配规则中进行选择。固定折将候选决策与用于定向其偏好的终端结果分离开来，而依赖支持度的证据权重则在共享的GraphGPO任务学习之外，对辅助成对目标进行缩放。MCGPO复用rollout数据以及每个响应的原始历史，保持无critic（价值函数）的训练方式（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: MCGPO通过匹配上下文从已有轨迹中构建加权动作偏好，在无需critic和额外rollout的情况下，为稀疏终端反馈下长时程LLM智能体的中间决策分配信用。
en_tdlr: MCGPO constructs matched-context weighted action preferences from already collected trajectories, enabling critic-free credit assignment to intermediate decisions of long-horizon LLM agents under sparse terminal feedback.
